intro: Lebanon packs sea, mountains and a fertile valley into an area smaller than many regions of Europe.

chapters.title: Two mountain ranges
text: A narrow coastal plain runs along the Mediterranean. Behind it rises Mount Lebanon, snowy in winter, where you can ski in the morning and swim in the afternoon. The Beqaa Valley, Lebanon's farm belt, lies between it and the Anti-Lebanon range on the Syrian border.
The cedar tree on the flag once covered the mountains; only small groves remain.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The coast has hot, humid summers and mild, rainy winters. The mountains get heavy snow.

keyTerms.meaning: An evergreen tree and national symbol.
